title: QA Generation Chain
summary: This module provides a deprecated chain for generating question-answer pairs from input text using an LLM, text splitting, and JSON parsing. It outlines an alternative, more modern approach using LangChain Expression Language (LCEL) runnables for improved functionality.

nodes.label: Input Document Text
nodes.title: Input Document Text
nodes.description: The raw text document provided as input to the QA generation process.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Text Splitter
nodes.description: An instance of RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter that divides the input document into smaller, overlapping text chunks.

nodes.label: LLM Chain for QA
nodes.title: LLM Chain for QA
nodes.description: An internal LLMChain instance that takes text chunks and a prompt to generate raw QA output from the language model.

nodes.label: Large Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Large Language Model (LLM)
nodes.description: The underlying AI model (e.g., ChatOpenAI) that processes text and generates responses based on the provided prompt.

nodes.label: QA Generation Prompt
nodes.title: QA Generation Prompt
nodes.description: A specific prompt template designed to instruct the LLM to generate question-answer pairs from given text.

nodes.label: Process LLM Output (JSON)
nodes.title: Process LLM Output (JSON)
nodes.description: Parses the raw text output from the LLM using `json.loads` to extract structured question-answer pairs.

nodes.label: Generated QA Pairs
nodes.title: Generated QA Pairs
nodes.description: The final output of the chain, consisting of structured question-answer pairs derived from the input document.

groups.label: QAGenerationChain (Deprecated)
groups.title: QAGenerationChain (Deprecated)
groups.description: This deprecated chain orchestrates the process of generating question-answer pairs from a document. It splits text, uses an LLM to generate QAs for each chunk, and parses the output. Users are encouraged to use the provided LCEL alternative.
